pure.title: Pure Offline
pure.description: All external resources are ignored, no internet access is used.

download.title: Download Only
download.description: External resources (e.g., links, images) are normally fetched.

add.warning: Please Select An Output Format First

right.hintformat: Select An Output Format To Get Started
right.hinttask: Add New Files Or Select A Task To Proceed

conversion.targetFirst: Choose a target, then add your files
conversion.chooseTarget: Choose an output format on the left. Available routes depend on your files and installed tools.
conversion.importHint: Folders: first level only, up to 200 files.
conversion.installTools: FFmpeg/ffprobe are included with FormatBay releases. If the bundled copy is missing or damaged, reinstall FormatBay.
conversion.besideInput: Beside the input, with a new name. Never overwrites the original.
conversion.noTasks: No tasks yet. Choose a target and add files.
conversion.outputHint: Output folder applies to newly added tasks. All current conversions run locally, even when Pure Offline is off.
conversion.encoderHint: Applies to new tasks. Automatic chooses a suitable route; opusenc selects the final encoder and adds an intermediate conversion when needed.
conversion.optionalTool: Optional tool not installed. Automatic can still use available encoders.
conversion.scope: FormatBay plans each file separately with installed tools. Review its route and warnings before starting.

toolManager.manual: Optional tools can be managed on Windows x64. Bundled tools and tools on PATH cannot be removed here.
toolManager.network: This downloads and installs a tool from the source below. It uses the network even when offline mode is enabled; your media files are not uploaded. Review the source and license before continuing.
toolManager.ffmpegBundled: FFmpeg/ffprobe are bundled. Their version and supported formats are set by this FormatBay release.

config.title: Config
config.intro: Settings for files you add next. Existing tasks keep their own settings.
config.opusencDefaults: The optional opusenc route uses its own defaults. Choose Automatic above to set FFmpeg audio options.
config.videoCopyOnly: This release can only copy a compatible source video track into this format. Video encoding and resizing are unavailable.
config.videoSubtitleWarning: This video format does not retain subtitle tracks in FormatBay.
config.subtitleHint: Only text subtitle tracks are supported. When no track is specified, FormatBay picks the first supported track.
config.automaticReview: Automatic defaults based on the input and target format.

error.range: Enter a whole number from {min} to {max} that fits the field rules.
error.rateConflict: Set either CRF or video bitrate, not both.
error.trackConflict: The default track must match the only track you selected.

codec.label: Audio codec
codec.hint: Automatic preserves compatible audio when possible. When you set other audio options, it uses the format’s default codec.

sampleRate.label: Sample rate (Hz)
sampleRate.hint: Available rates depend on the codec. Leave Automatic to use suitable settings from the input.

bitrateKbps.label: Audio bitrate (kbps)
bitrateKbps.hint: Set a bitrate for lossy audio, or leave Automatic.

channels.label: Audio channels
channels.hint: Select the output channel count, or leave Automatic. A smaller count can downmix the input.

videoCodec.label: Video codec
videoCodec.hint: Choose an available encoder, or leave Automatic to let FormatBay choose a route.

crf.label: Quality (CRF)
crf.hint: 0–51. Lower values generally improve quality and increase size. Use CRF or bitrate, not both.

videoBitrateKbps.label: Video bitrate (kbps)
videoBitrateKbps.hint: 100–50,000 kbps. Use bitrate or CRF, not both.

frameRate.label: Frame rate (fps)
frameRate.hint: 1–120 frames per second. Leave blank to use the source and encoder defaults.

width.label: Width (pixels)
width.hint: Even number, {min}–{max}. Set one dimension to keep the aspect ratio.

height.label: Height (pixels)
height.hint: Even number, {min}–{max}. Set one dimension to keep the aspect ratio.

audioTrack.label: Keep only audio track
audioTrack.hint: 0 is the first audio track. Leave blank for automatic track selection.

subtitleTrack.label: Subtitle track
subtitleTrack.hint: 0 is the first subtitle track. Set an index to select just that track.

defaultAudioTrack.label: Default audio track
defaultAudioTrack.hint: 0 is the first audio track in the input. Applies only if retained.

defaultSubtitleTrack.label: Default subtitle track
defaultSubtitleTrack.hint: 0 is the first subtitle track in the input. Applies only if retained.

dropSubtitles.label: Remove all subtitles
dropSubtitles.hint: Discard subtitle tracks instead of keeping compatible ones.

pixelFormat.label: Pixel format
pixelFormat.hint: Optional 10-bit HEVC output. Playback needs a compatible decoder.

config.inputTracksHint: Use these zero-based track numbers when configuring a new import.
